newsitem.title: LATVIA: VALMIERA SEES GOOD Q1, TURNOVER LOWER.
newsitem.headline: VALMIERA SEES GOOD Q1, TURNOVER LOWER.

text.p: Valmiera Glassfibre factory said on Monday, that its first quarter results are good although turnover was slightly lower at 2.54 million lats against 2.804 million lats in the same period of 1995.

"We will have a good first quarter balance as the expenditure side and cash flow is very good..Our turnover goes according to plan, close to last year's level," Imants Saulitis, finance manager, told Reuters.
"We plan to propose a turnover of 10.5 million lats for 1997 to our shareholders," Saulitis said.

"Winter months are usually harder for Valmiera's turnover as lots of our materials are used in construction, in preparing for winter...I would say that this (the Q1) turnover figure is a normal one," he added.
"We will have (Q1) profit and loss figures available on Wednesday," he added.
